$comment: PERMANENT money/game firewall tests (blueprint §26.2 rule 3). tools/check-firewall.mjs fails CI if any ID below is missing from a test title in this folder, or if a test is skipped. Add IDs; never remove them.

tests.FW-001: Sparks cannot be converted to or from Points, Trophies or match chips, in either direction
tests.FW-002: No game accepts any entry payment: not Sparks, not a purchased item, not any currency
tests.FW-004: No game reward is a subscription, pass, book, creator item, gift or anything worth money
tests.FW-005: A cosmetic sold for money can never be a game reward
tests.FW-006: The Sparks ledger accepts only purchase, milestone, spend and reversal sources (never a game)
tests.FW-007: Earned (milestone) Sparks are capped at 50 a month
tests.FW-008: The games module never references entitlements, billing, Pro or passes (no paid game advantage)
tests.FW-009: Ranked duel cap is 10 a day and is a constant, identical for every player
